findings.title: Document the retired fallback contract
findings.why_it_matters: This changes the operational contract from an in-place turn-based fallback to refusal and real-time reconnect. Without an append-only decision entry, later work can restore the old manual path or misread a 409 as an accidental regression, recreating the student-facing failure this repair addresses.
findings.suggested_fix: Append one dated entry to lms/docs/DECISIONS.md that supersedes its 2026-07-28 turn-based-degradation decisions: graded interviews admit only when the current agent heartbeat is healthy, reconnect through LiveKit, and retire manual recording endpoints; include the rejected manual-fallback alternative.

The scoped diff has no lms/docs/DECISIONS.md change, so it neither records this supersession nor preserves the rationale required by the governing rule.

residual_risks: The reviewed diff does not prove production LiveKit Egress quota availability; agent recording remains best-effort and provider-account capacity must be checked separately before claiming recordings work.

The fail-closed heartbeat check intentionally treats every fresh agent replica with a mismatched SHA or nonzero error count as unavailable. This safety posture is not covered here against a rolling-deploy multi-replica sequence.
testing_gaps: The new heartbeat tests exercise only the pure predicate. They do not exercise POST /api/interview/token with verified, stale, mismatched, and errored ServiceHeartbeat rows.
The client contract test is source-text based; it does not run a LiveKit disconnect/rejoin lifecycle or prove that stale manual endpoint calls cannot mutate an interview in a deployed browser.
No scoped automated test constructs the installed ElevenLabs plugin with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, so plugin API compatibility is still a runtime verification item.
